rules.source_excerpt: This OpenAI Services Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered as of the Effective Date between the organization agreeing to these terms (“Customer”) and the OpenAI Contracting Party defined below (“OpenAI”). In this Agreement, OpenAI and Customer are each referred to as a “Party” and collectively as the “Parties.” Capitalized terms not defined in the Agreement have the meanings provided in the Order Form. Customer represents it is lawfully able to enter into this Agreement and, if it is entering into the Agreement for an entity, that it has legal authority to bind that entity. By clicking “I agree,” accepting the Order Form, or using the Services, Customer agrees to this Agreement.
rules.scope_note: Agreement preamble; use of Services is one of the stated methods by which Customer agrees to the Agreement.
rules.condition_explanation: acceptance_by_click_order_form_acceptance_or_service_use means Customer accepts by clicking “I agree,” accepting the Order Form, or using the Services.

rules.source_excerpt: 1.1. Services Term. OpenAI will deliver the Services to Customer for the Services Term. The Services Term will be listed on the Order Form. Unless the Parties agree otherwise in writing, increases in the Services purchased during a Services Term will have a prorated term ending concurrently with the then‑current Services Term.
rules.scope_note: Section 1.1; OpenAI must deliver the Services to Customer for the Services Term listed on the Order Form.
rules.condition_explanation: Services Term is specified in the applicable Order Form; increases purchased during a Services Term are prorated to end with the then-current Services Term unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.

obligation_items.content: Deliver the Services to Customer for the Services Term.
obligation_items.object: Services
obligation_items.trigger: During the Services Term listed on the Order Form, subject to any written agreement otherwise for the term of service increases.

rules.source_excerpt: 1.2. Renewal. Renewal Terms, if any, and whether the Services auto renew, will be listed on the applicable Order Form. Notice of non‑renewal or scope reduction must be given at least thirty days before the start of the next Renewal Term. If Customer reduces its license count, quantity, or minimum commitment, OpenAI may adjust or remove discounts offered to Customer based on its prior purchase.
rules.scope_note: Section 1.2; applies when Customer gives notice of non-renewal or scope reduction for a Renewal Term.
rules.condition_explanation: notice_at_least_30_days_before_next_renewal_term means the notice is given at least 30 days before the next Renewal Term starts. Whether renewal occurs and whether Services auto-renew are determined by the Order Form.

obligation_items.content: Give notice of non-renewal or scope reduction at least 30 days before the start of the next Renewal Term.
obligation_items.object: Services renewal or scope
obligation_items.trigger: When Customer elects non-renewal or scope reduction for a Renewal Term.

rules.source_excerpt: b. Purchases. The Services may be configured to allow Authorized Purchasers to purchase additional licenses, quantities, or volumes of Services. Customer is responsible for understanding the Services settings that allow additional purchases. OpenAI will charge Customer for additional licenses, quantities, or volumes of Services for the remainder of the then‑current Services Term based on Customer’s then‑current price unless otherwise set forth on the Order Form.
rules.scope_note: Section 1.3(b); Authorized Purchasers may purchase additional licenses, quantities, or volumes only where the Services are configured to allow those purchases.
rules.condition_explanation: services_configured_to_allow_additional_purchases is the stated configuration condition. The charge is based on Customer’s then-current price for the remainder of the then-current Services Term unless the Order Form provides otherwise.

obligation_items.content: Pay the charge for additional licenses, quantities, or volumes for the remainder of the then-current Services Term at the then-current price, unless the Order Form provides otherwise.
obligation_items.object: Additional Services purchased by Authorized Purchasers
obligation_items.trigger: When an Authorized Purchaser purchases additional licenses, quantities, or volumes through a configuration that permits such purchases.

rules.source_excerpt: a. Usage. OpenAI provisions the Services to specific entities using dedicated workspaces and organizational IDs. Customer Affiliates may use the Services under Customer’s Account, which means Customer and its Affiliates usage will occur in the same workspace and under the same organizational ID. Customer will be responsible and liable for all acts and omissions of its Affiliates that access the Services in connection with this Agreement.
rules.scope_note: Section 1.4(a); Affiliate use under Customer’s Account occurs in the same workspace and organizational ID as Customer. Customer is responsible and liable for Affiliate acts and omissions connected with the Agreement.
rules.condition_explanation: affiliate_accesses_services_in_connection_with_agreement means the Affiliate accesses the Services in connection with this Agreement.

obligation_items.content: Be responsible and liable for all acts and omissions of its Affiliates that access the Services in connection with the Agreement.
obligation_items.object: Affiliate use of Services under Customer’s Account
obligation_items.trigger: When a Customer Affiliate accesses the Services in connection with this Agreement.

rules.source_excerpt: b. Separate Purchases. If Customer Affiliates’ purchase and use of the Services is intended to be separate from Customer’s, then the Affiliate must execute a separate Order Form. OpenAI will then create a separate workspace and organizational ID for that Affiliate and provision the Services accordingly. If Customer Affiliates enter into Order Forms under this Agreement they will be bound by this Agreement.
rules.scope_note: Section 1.4(b); when Affiliate purchase and use is intended to be separate from Customer’s, the Affiliate must execute a separate Order Form; OpenAI then creates a separate workspace and organizational ID and provisions Services accordingly. Affiliates entering Order Forms under the Agreement are bound by it.
rules.condition_explanation: affiliate_purchase_and_use_intended_separate_from_customer is the stated condition for requiring a separate Order Form.

obligation_items.content: Execute a separate Order Form for separate Affiliate purchase and use.
obligation_items.object: Separate Affiliate Services purchase
obligation_items.trigger: When Affiliate purchase and use of the Services is intended to be separate from Customer’s.

obligation_items.content: Create a separate workspace and organizational ID and provision the Services accordingly.
obligation_items.object: Separate Affiliate Services account and workspace
obligation_items.trigger: After the Affiliate executes the separate Order Form.

rules.source_excerpt: 1.5. Usage‑based Services. If Customer purchases Services based on usage, Customer acknowledges that OpenAI will charge Customer the Fees for the Services based on the usage calculated by OpenAI.
rules.scope_note: Section 1.5; applies to Services purchased based on usage.
rules.condition_explanation: customer_purchases_usage_based_services means Customer purchases Services on a usage basis; fees are based on usage calculated by OpenAI.

obligation_items.content: Pay Fees for usage-based Services based on usage calculated by OpenAI.
obligation_items.object: Usage-based Services
obligation_items.trigger: When Customer purchases Services based on usage.

rules.source_excerpt:
2.1. General. The Agreement governs Customer’s access to and use of the Services. Customer may access and use the Services in accordance with the Agreement.
2.2. Use. OpenAI grants Customer a non‑exclusive right to access and use the Services during the Term. This includes the right to use OpenAI’s API to integrate the Services into Customer Applications and to make Customer Applications available to End Users.
rules.scope_note: Sections 2.1–2.2; non-exclusive right to access and use Services during the Term, including use of the API to integrate Services into Customer Applications and make those applications available to End Users.
rules.condition_explanation: during_term means while the Agreement’s Term is in effect. in_accordance_with_agreement requires compliance with applicable Agreement terms.

rules.source_excerpt: 2.2. Use. OpenAI grants Customer a non‑exclusive right to access and use the Services during the Term. This includes the right to use OpenAI’s API to integrate the Services into Customer Applications and to make Customer Applications available to End Users.
rules.scope_note: Section 2.2; includes using OpenAI’s API to integrate Services into Customer Applications and making those applications available to End Users.
rules.condition_explanation: during_term means while the Agreement’s Term is in effect; the integration and availability remain subject to the Agreement.

rules.source_excerpt: 2.3. Modifications. OpenAI may update the Services periodically. If an OpenAI update materially reduces the Services functionality, OpenAI will notify Customer at the Account email address. Within five business days of receipt of this notice, Customer may choose to terminate the Agreement by providing thirty days written notice. This termination right will not apply to updates made to features provided on a beta or evaluation basis.
rules.scope_note: Section 2.3; termination right for an OpenAI update materially reducing Services functionality; excluded for features provided on a beta or evaluation basis.
rules.condition_explanation: The condition requires a material reduction in Services functionality, notice at the Account email address, Customer’s election within five business days after receiving notice, and 30 days’ written termination notice. The right does not apply to updates to beta or evaluation features.

obligation_items.content: Give OpenAI 30 days’ written notice of termination after electing to terminate within five business days of receiving the update notice.
obligation_items.object: Agreement
obligation_items.trigger: An OpenAI update materially reduces Services functionality, OpenAI notifies Customer at the Account email address, and the update is not to a beta or evaluation feature.

rules.source_excerpt: 3.1. Customer Account. Customer must provide accurate and current Account information. Customer will not share Account access credentials or individual login credentials between multiple users. Customer may not resell or lease access to its Account or any End User Account. Customer will promptly notify OpenAI if it becomes aware of unauthorized access to the Account or the Services.
rules.scope_note: Section 3.1; governs Customer Account information and access credentials, resale or lease of Account or End User Account access, and notice of unauthorized access.
rules.condition_explanation: The rule requires accurate, current Account information; prohibits sharing Account access credentials or individual login credentials between multiple users and reselling or leasing access to the Account or an End User Account; and requires prompt notice upon awareness of unauthorized access.

obligation_items.content: Provide accurate and current Account information.
obligation_items.object: Customer Account information
obligation_items.trigger: While maintaining or using the Customer Account.

obligation_items.content: Do not share Account access credentials or individual login credentials between multiple users.
obligation_items.object: Account access credentials and individual login credentials
obligation_items.trigger: At all times.

obligation_items.content: Do not resell or lease access to the Account or any End User Account.
obligation_items.object: Account or End User Account access
obligation_items.trigger: At all times.

obligation_items.content: Promptly notify OpenAI of unauthorized access to the Account or Services.
obligation_items.object: Customer Account or Services
obligation_items.trigger: Promptly after Customer becomes aware of unauthorized access.

rules.source_excerpt: 3.2. End Users. End User Accounts may only be provisioned to, registered for, and used by, a single End User. Customer is responsible for all activities that occur under its Account, including the activities of End Users with an End User Account or who access the Services through a Customer Application. Customer will obtain and maintain from End Users any consents necessary to allow Administrators to engage in the activities described in the Agreement and to allow OpenAI to deliver the Services.
rules.scope_note: Section 3.2; applies to End User Accounts, activities under Customer’s Account, and consents necessary for Administrators’ Agreement-described activities and OpenAI’s service delivery.

rules.source_excerpt: 3.3. Restrictions. 7.1. Use and Nondisclosure. Recipient agrees it will: (a) only use Discloser's Confidential Information to exercise its rights and fulfill its obligations under this Agreement; (b) take reasonable measures to protect the Confidential Information; and (c) not disclose the Confidential Information to any third party except as expressly permitted in this Agreement.
7.2. Exceptions. The obligations in Section 7.1 do not apply to information that: (a) is or becomes generally available to the public through no fault of Recipient; (b) was in Recipient’s possession or known by it prior to receipt from Discloser; (c) was rightfully disclosed to Recipient without restriction by a third party; or (d) was independently developed without use of Discloser’s Confidential Information.
7.3. Permitted Disclosure. Recipient may disclose Confidential Information only to its Affiliates, employees, contractors, and agents who have a need to know and who are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as restrictive as those in this Agreement. Recipient will be responsible for any breach of this Section 7 by its employees, contractors, and agents. Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law, if Recipient uses reasonable efforts to notify Discloser, to the extent permitted, prior to doing so.
rules.scope_note: Section 7.1(a): applies to a Recipient’s use of the Discloser’s Confidential Information; Confidential Information includes Customer Content. Section 7.2 exceptions apply where the information is public through no fault of Recipient, was previously possessed or known, was rightfully disclosed without restriction by a third party, or was independently developed without use of the Confidential Information.
rules.condition_explanation: use_only_to_exercise_agreement_rights_or_fulfill_agreement_obligations means the Recipient uses the Discloser’s Confidential Information only for those purposes, subject to the Section 7.2 exceptions.

rules.source_excerpt: 11.3. Effects of Termination. If this Agreement terminates: (a) the rights granted by OpenAI to Customer will cease immediately; and (b) OpenAI will delete all Customer Content from its systems within thirty days, unless: (i) OpenAI is legally required to retain it; or (ii) Customer has agreed otherwise in writing. Termination or expiration will not affect any rights or obligations, including the payment of amounts due, which have accrued under this Agreement up to the date of termination. In addition, except for a termination by Customer for cause, if this Agreement terminates any unpaid minimum commitment amounts set forth on the Order form will become immediately due. Despite anything to the contrary in this Agreement, OpenAI may retain Abusive Customer Content, or, if Customer’s access to the Services is suspended via Section 8 or terminated via Section 11, share information related to Abusive Customer Content, as required by law, or as reasonably necessary to protect the Services or any third party from harm.

a. Generally. OpenAI may update this Agreement, or OpenAI Policies, by providing Customer with reasonable notice, including by posting the update on OpenAI’s website. If OpenAI determines in its sole judgment that an update materially impacts Customer’s rights or obligations, OpenAI will provide Customer at least thirty days’ notice before the update is effective, unless the update is necessary for OpenAI to comply with applicable law, in which case OpenAI will provide Customer with as much notice as reasonably possible. Any other updates will be effective on the date OpenAI posts the updated Agreement or OpenAI Policy. Customer’s continued use of, or access to, the Services after an update is effective constitutes acceptance of the update. If Customer does not agree with an update, Customer may stop using the Services or terminate this Agreement under Section 11.
b. Exceptions. Except for an update to comply with applicable law, updates to this Agreement or the OpenAI Policies will not apply to: (i) Disputes between Customer and OpenAI arising prior to the update; or (ii) Order Forms signed by Customer and OpenAI (as opposed to an automated ordering page) prior to OpenAI notifying Customer of the update. However, to the extent an update relates to a Service or feature launched after an Order Form is signed it will be effective upon Customer’s first use of that Service.
rules.scope_note: Section 16.13 provides that Customer’s continued use of or access to the Services after an update becomes effective constitutes acceptance of that update. Customer may instead stop using the Services or terminate under Section 11. Update exceptions and timing are set out in Section 16.13(b).
rules.condition_explanation: an_agreement_or_policy_update_is_effective depends on the notice and effective-date rules in Section 16.13(a). Material-impact updates generally require at least 30 days’ notice, except updates necessary to comply with law, for which OpenAI gives as much notice as reasonably possible; other updates generally take effect when posted. Except for updates to comply with law, updates do not apply to earlier-arising Disputes or qualifying signed Order Forms made before notice. An update relating to a later-launched Service or feature applies upon Customer’s first use of that Service or feature.

I.2.a. Each party may terminate these Terms at any time for convenience with Notice, except Anthropic must provide 30 days prior Notice.
I.2.b. Either party may terminate these Terms for the other party’s material breach by providing 30 days prior Notice detailing the nature of the breach unless cured within that time.

obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a verbatim copy of the Program's source code as received.

rules.source_excerpt: You may charge any price or no price for each copy that you convey, and you may offer support or warranty protection for a fee.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §4; permits charging any price or no price for each conveyed verbatim copy and offering support or warranty protection for a fee.
rules.condition_explanation: convey_verbatim_copy_under_section_4 means a verbatim source copy is conveyed under §4, subject to applicable conditions.

rules.source_excerpt:
You may convey a work based on the Program, or the modifications to produce it from the Program, in the form of source code under the terms of section 4, provided that you also meet all of these conditions:
a) The work must carry prominent notices stating that you modified it, and giving a relevant date.
b) The work must carry prominent notices stating that it is released under this License and any conditions added under section 7. This requirement modifies the requirement in section 4 to "keep intact all notices".
c) You must license the entire work, as a whole, under this License to anyone who comes into possession of a copy. This License will therefore apply, along with any applicable section 7 additional terms, to the whole of the work, and all its parts, regardless of how they are packaged. This License gives no permission to license the work in any other way, but it does not invalidate such permission if you have separately received it.
d) If the work has interactive user interfaces, each must display Appropriate Legal Notices; however, if the Program has interactive interfaces that do not display Appropriate Legal Notices, your work need not make them do so.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §5; applies to conveying a work based on the Program or modifications to produce it in source-code form. The interface notice condition has the stated exception.
rules.condition_explanation: section_4_conditions are applicable §4 conditions. The whole-work licensing rule applies to the whole work and all its parts, regardless of packaging; it does not invalidate separately received permission to license otherwise.

obligation_items.content: Carry prominent notices stating that the work was modified and giving a relevant date.
obligation_items.object: modified source-code work
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a work based on the Program or modifications to produce it in source-code form.

obligation_items.content: Carry prominent notices stating that the work is released under the License and any conditions added under section 7.
obligation_items.object: modified source-code work
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a work based on the Program or modifications to produce it in source-code form.

obligation_items.content: License the entire work, as a whole, under the License to anyone who comes into possession of a copy.
obligation_items.object: entire modified work and all its parts, regardless of packaging
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying the work in source-code form; subject to any separately received permission that allows other licensing.

obligation_items.content: Display Appropriate Legal Notices in each interactive user interface.
obligation_items.object: each interactive user interface of the modified work
obligation_items.trigger: When the work has interactive user interfaces, except an interface need not display notices if the Program's interactive interfaces do not display Appropriate Legal Notices.

rules.source_excerpt: A compilation of a covered work with other separate and independent works, which are not by their nature extensions of the covered work, and which are not combined with it such as to form a larger program, in or on a volume of a storage or distribution medium, is called an "aggregate" if the compilation and its resulting copyright are not used to limit the access or legal rights of the compilation's users beyond what the individual works permit. Inclusion of a covered work in an aggregate does not cause this License to apply to the other parts of the aggregate.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §5; inclusion of a covered work in an aggregate does not cause the License to apply to other aggregate parts.
rules.condition_explanation: The conditions describe the defined aggregate boundary: separate and independent works that are not extensions or combined into a larger program, and no restriction of users' rights beyond what the individual works permit.

rules.source_excerpt: You may convey a covered work in object code form under the terms of sections 4 and 5, provided that you also convey the machine-readable Corresponding Source under the terms of this License, in one of these ways:
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; object-code conveyance requires machine-readable Corresponding Source under the License through one applicable alternative in §6(a)–(e).
rules.condition_explanation: The §4 and §5 conditions apply as relevant. The source methods in §6(a)–(e) are alternatives, not cumulative requirements.

obligation_items.content: Convey the machine-readable Corresponding Source under the License by one applicable method in §6(a)–(e).
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for the object-code covered work
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a covered work in object-code form, in addition to applicable §4 and §5 conditions.

rules.source_excerpt: a) Convey the object code in, or embodied in, a physical product (including a physical distribution medium), accompanied by the Corresponding Source fixed on a durable physical medium customarily used for software interchange.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(a); one alternative for satisfying §6's Corresponding Source requirement.
rules.condition_explanation: This is one alternative among §6(a)–(e), not an additional cumulative condition.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the object code with Corresponding Source fixed on a durable physical medium customarily used for software interchange.
obligation_items.object: object code and its Corresponding Source
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code in or embodied in a physical product using §6(a).

rules.source_excerpt: b) Convey the object code in, or embodied in, a physical product (including a physical distribution medium), accompanied by a written offer, valid for at least three years and valid for as long as you offer spare parts or customer support for that product model, to give anyone who possesses the object code either (1) a copy of the Corresponding Source for all the software in the product that is covered by this License, on a durable physical medium customarily used for software interchange, for a price no more than your reasonable cost of physically performing this conveying of source, or (2) access to copy the Corresponding Source from a network server at no charge.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(b); one alternative for satisfying §6's Corresponding Source requirement. The offer provides either a physical source copy at no more than reasonable physical conveyance cost or no-charge network access to copy source.
rules.condition_explanation: The written offer is for anyone possessing the object code. It must remain valid for at least three years and as long as spare parts or customer support are offered for that product model. The price cap applies to the physical-copy option.

obligation_items.content: Provide a written offer to give any possessor of the object code either a Corresponding Source copy on a customary durable physical medium for no more than reasonable physical conveyance cost, or no-charge network access to copy it.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for all software in the product covered by the License
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code in or embodied in a physical product using §6(b).

obligation_items.content: Keep the written offer valid for at least three years and for as long as spare parts or customer support are offered for that product model.
obligation_items.object: written source offer for the product model
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code using §6(b).

rules.source_excerpt: c) Convey individual copies of the object code with a copy of the written offer to provide the Corresponding Source. This alternative is allowed only occasionally and noncommercially, and only if you received the object code with such an offer, in accord with subsection 6b.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(c); limited alternative for conveying individual object-code copies with the written offer.
rules.condition_explanation: Conveyance must be both occasional and noncommercial, and the actor must have received the object code with an offer in accordance with §6(b).

rules.source_excerpt: d) Convey the object code by offering access from a designated place (gratis or for a charge), and offer equivalent access to the Corresponding Source in the same way through the same place at no further charge. You need not require recipients to copy the Corresponding Source along with the object code. If the place to copy the object code is a network server, the Corresponding Source may be on a different server (operated by you or a third party) that supports equivalent copying facilities, provided you maintain clear directions next to the object code saying where to find the Corresponding Source. Regardless of what server hosts the Corresponding Source, you remain obligated to ensure that it is available for as long as needed to satisfy these requirements.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(d); object-code access may be gratis or for a charge. Source may be hosted on a different server if it supports equivalent copying facilities; recipients need not be required to copy source with object code.
rules.condition_explanation: Equivalent source access must be through the same place and in the same way, with no further charge. Clear directions are required if object code is offered from a network server. The source-availability duty applies regardless of hosting server.

obligation_items.content: Offer equivalent access to Corresponding Source through the same place and in the same way as object-code access, at no further charge.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source and object code
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code by offering access from a designated place.

obligation_items.content: Place clear directions next to the object code stating where to find Corresponding Source.
obligation_items.object: object-code offering and source-location directions
obligation_items.trigger: When the place to copy object code is a network server.

obligation_items.content: Ensure Corresponding Source remains available for as long as needed to satisfy the source-conveyance requirements.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code using §6(d), regardless of which server hosts the source.

rules.source_excerpt: e) Convey the object code using peer-to-peer transmission, provided you inform other peers where the object code and Corresponding Source of the work are being offered to the general public at no charge under subsection 6d.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(e); peer-to-peer alternative incorporates §6(d)'s public no-charge offering requirement.
rules.condition_explanation: The actor must inform peers where both object code and Corresponding Source are offered to the general public at no charge under §6(d).

obligation_items.content: Inform other peers where the object code and Corresponding Source are offered to the general public at no charge under §6(d).
obligation_items.object: peer-to-peer object-code transmission and source-location information
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code using peer-to-peer transmission.

rules.source_excerpt: A separable portion of the object code, whose source code is excluded from the Corresponding Source as a System Library, need not be included in conveying the object code work.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; exception concerning what must be included when conveying the object-code work.
rules.condition_explanation: A separable object-code portion whose source is excluded from Corresponding Source as a System Library need not be included in conveying the object-code work.

rules.source_excerpt: If you convey an object code work under this section in, or with, or specifically for use in, a User Product, and the conveying occurs as part of a transaction in which the right of possession and use of the User Product is transferred to the recipient in perpetuity or for a fixed term (regardless of how the transaction is characterized), the Corresponding Source conveyed under this section must be accompanied by the Installation Information. But this requirement does not apply if neither you nor any third party retains the ability to install modified object code on the User Product (for example, the work has been installed in ROM).
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; when the stated User Product transaction conditions apply, Installation Information must accompany Corresponding Source unless neither the conveyor nor any third party can install modified object code on the product.
rules.condition_explanation: Applicability requires conveyance under §6, the specified relationship to a User Product, and transfer of possession and use in perpetuity or for a fixed term. The two alternatives are: provide Installation Information, or the stated inability of either the conveyor or any third party to install modified object code.

obligation_items.content: Accompany Corresponding Source with Installation Information sufficient to install and execute modified versions from modified Corresponding Source.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source and User Product
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code under §6 in, with, or specifically for a User Product in a transaction transferring possession and use in perpetuity or for a fixed term, unless neither the conveyor nor any third party retains the ability to install modified object code on the product.

rules.source_excerpt: The requirement to provide Installation Information does not include a requirement to continue to provide support service, warranty, or updates for a work that has been modified or installed by the recipient, or for the User Product in which it has been modified or installed. Access to a network may be denied when the modification itself materially and adversely affects the operation of the network or violates the rules and protocols for communication across the network.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; Installation Information does not require continuing support, warranty, or updates for a work or User Product modified or installed by the recipient. Network access may be denied on the stated grounds.
rules.condition_explanation: The no-continuing-service statement limits the Installation Information requirement. The stated access-denial grounds require that the modification itself materially and adversely affects network operation or violates network communication rules and protocols.

rules.source_excerpt: Corresponding Source conveyed, and Installation Information provided, in accord with this section must be in a format that is publicly documented (and with an implementation available to the public in source code form), and must require no special password or key for unpacking, reading or copying.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; applies to Corresponding Source conveyed and Installation Information provided under that section.
rules.condition_explanation: The format must be publicly documented, have an implementation available publicly in source-code form, and require no special password or key for unpacking, reading, or copying.

obligation_items.content: Provide Corresponding Source and Installation Information in a publicly documented format with an implementation available to the public in source-code form, requiring no special password or key to unpack, read, or copy.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source and Installation Information
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying Corresponding Source or providing Installation Information under §6.

If the Program as you received it, or any part of it, contains a notice stating that it is governed by this License along with a term that is a further restriction, you may remove that term. rules.source_excerpt: If you add terms to a covered work in accord with this section, you must place, in the relevant source files, a statement of the additional terms that apply to those files, or a notice indicating where to find the applicable terms.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later, section 7. When adding terms to a covered work under this section, the licensee must put in relevant source files either a statement of the additional terms applying to those files or a notice indicating where to find the terms.

obligation_items.content: Place in the relevant source files either a statement of the additional terms that apply to those files or a notice indicating where to find the applicable terms.
obligation_items.object: relevant source files for the covered work to which the additional terms apply
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee adds terms to a covered work in accordance with section 7.

obligation_items.content: Do not propagate a covered work except as expressly provided under the License.

obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the actor would propagate the covered work.

rules.source_excerpt: You may not propagate or modify a covered work except as expressly provided under this License. Any attempt otherwise to propagate or modify it is void, and will automatically terminate your rights under this License (including any patent licenses granted under the third paragraph of section 11).

rules.condition_explanation: modification_not_expressly_provided_by_license means modification of a covered work not expressly provided for by the License.

obligation_items.content: Do not modify a covered work except as expressly provided under the License.

rules.source_excerpt: However, if you cease all violation of this License, then your license from a particular copyright holder is reinstated (a) provisionally, unless and until the copyright holder explicitly and finally terminates your license, and (b) permanently, if the copyright holder fails to notify you of the violation by some reasonable means prior to 60 days after the cessation.

After the licensee ceases all violations, the license from a particular copyright holder is reinstated provisionally unless and until that holder explicitly and finally terminates it; it is reinstated permanently if that holder fails to notify the licensee of the violation by reasonable means before 60 days after cessation.

Permanent reinstatement additionally depends on no reasonable notice from the particular copyright holder before 60 days after cessation; absent that condition, reinstatement is provisional unless finally terminated by that holder.

rules.source_excerpt: Moreover, your license from a particular copyright holder is reinstated permanently if the copyright holder notifies you of the violation by some reasonable means, this is the first time you have received notice of violation of this License (for any work) from that copyright holder, and you cure the violation prior to 30 days after your receipt of the notice.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later, section 8. A particular copyright holder's license is permanently reinstated if that holder gives reasonable notice of the violation, it is the first notice from that holder of a License violation for any work, and the licensee cures before 30 days after receiving notice.
rules.condition_explanation: All three stated conditions are required. cure_before_30_days_after_receipt means cure occurs before 30 days have elapsed from receipt of the notice.

rules.source_excerpt: Termination of your rights under this section does not terminate the licenses of parties who have received copies or rights from you under this License. If your rights have been terminated and not permanently reinstated, you do not qualify to receive new licenses for the same material under section 10.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 §8: a person whose rights have been terminated and not permanently reinstated does not qualify to receive new licenses for the same material under §10. Existing licenses of parties who received copies or rights from that person are not terminated.
rules.condition_explanation: rights_terminated_and_not_permanently_reinstated means the person's rights under this section have been terminated and have not been permanently reinstated. The clause captures the stated bar on qualifying for a new license for the same material; it does not terminate downstream parties' licenses.

rules.source_excerpt: An "entity transaction" is a transaction transferring control of an organization, or substantially all assets of one, or subdividing an organization, or merging organizations. If propagation of a covered work results from an entity transaction, each party to that transaction who receives a copy of the work also receives whatever licenses to the work the party's predecessor in interest had or could give under the previous paragraph, plus a right to possession of the Corresponding Source of the work from the predecessor in interest, if the predecessor has it or can get it with reasonable efforts.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 §10: a party receiving a copy through propagation resulting from an entity transaction receives the licenses to the work that its predecessor in interest had or could give under §10's preceding paragraph.
rules.condition_explanation: entity_transaction means a transaction transferring control of an organization, substantially all its assets, subdividing an organization, or merging organizations. propagation_results_from_entity_transaction_and_party_receives_copy means propagation of the covered work results from such a transaction and the party receives a copy. predecessor_license_scope is limited to licenses the predecessor had or could give under §10's preceding paragraph.

rules.source_excerpt: 2. Customer and End User Accounts. Use of Mistral AI Products on Mistral AI Infrastructure requires an account (“Customer Account”). Customer must provide complete and accurate account information when setting up its Customer Account, including accurate billing information and a valid method of payment. Subject to applicable limitations (e.g., a maximum number of seat licenses), Customer may create End User Accounts under its Customer Account to enable End Users to receive direct access to the Mistral AI Products. Customer must ensure that all account details for its Customer Account and all End User accounts (“End-User Accounts”) remain accurate and all account credentials remain confidential at all times. End User Accounts may not be shared, sold, licensed, or otherwise made available outside of Customer’s entity or organization. For the avoidance of doubt, but subject to the agreement under which Customer is authorized to access and use Mistral AI Products, Customer may create End User Accounts for End Users of its Affiliates. Customer must promptly notify Mistral AI at support@mistral.ai or through the Help Center in the event Customer detects any unauthorized or fraudulent access or use of its Customer Account, any End User Account, or any Customer Offering.
rules.scope_note: Additional Product Terms, section 2, concerns Customer Accounts and End User Accounts for access to Mistral AI Products on Mistral AI Infrastructure. Account information includes accurate billing information and a valid payment method.
rules.condition_explanation: Use on the specified infrastructure requires an account. Account information must be complete and accurate at setup, account and End User Account details must remain accurate, and credentials must remain confidential at all times.

rules.source_excerpt: 4. Sharing Conversation Links. Certain Mistral AI Products provide users with the ability to share unique links to conversations with third parties (each, a “Conversation Link”). Anyone with the Conversation Link will be able to view Customer’s conversation, including any person with whom Customer’s intended recipient shares the Conversation Link. Customer acknowledges that Mistral AI does not monitor or control who accesses conversations via Conversation Links that Customer or an End User creates.
rules.scope_note: Additional Product Terms, section 4, concerns sharing unique links to conversations. Anyone with the link can view the Customer's conversation, including a person to whom the intended recipient further shares it. Customer acknowledges Mistral does not monitor or control access through links created by Customer or an End User.
rules.condition_explanation: The provision states the access consequence of creating a Conversation Link and records Customer's acknowledgment of the absence of Mistral monitoring or control. It does not expressly impose a separate duty to restrict recipients or monitor access.

rules.source_excerpt: 5. Third-Party Connectors. Customer may connect services not provided by Mistral AI (each, a “Third-Party Connector”), including Model Context Protocol Servers (“MCP Servers”), to Mistral AI Products. By enabling these connections, Customer grants us the permission to (a) access the Third-Party Connectors, (b) send Customer input to the Third-Party Connector, and (c) where applicable, execute actions upon Customer request, including to retrieve, process, store, execute, transmit, modify, delete, invoke, or otherwise act upon the necessary data to use content, systems, or resources in connection with generating Outputs or carrying out requested actions. Customer may only connect a Third-Party Connector to a Mistral AI Product if Customer has all necessary rights, licenses, and permissions to connect such Third-Party Connector to Mistral AI Products in accordance with these Terms. Customer is responsible for maintaining access to the Third-Party Connector for the duration of Customer subscription or Customer use of such features. Any use of a Third-Party Connector is subject to the respective terms and conditions for the Third-Party Connector, and Customer is solely responsible for complying with such terms and conditions, and for the actions Customer requests from Mistral AI Products through Customer input. Customer acknowledges that Third-Party Connectors are not Mistral AI Products and Mistral AI is not responsible for any Third-Party Connector or Customer use of any Third-Party Connector, including any disruptions, data loss, or issues with Mistral AI Products arising from Customer use of the Third-Party Connector. Furthermore, if Customer uses an MCP Server to connect a Mistral AI Product to a Third-Party Connector, Customer acknowledges that Mistral AI has no control over such third-party MCP Server and bears no responsibility for Customer use of such MCP Server, including any actions, executions, routing, modifications, accesses, storage, transfers, disclosures, corruption, or deletions of data, content, systems, resources, or environments performed by or through such MCP Server upon Customer request, or for how the MCP Server processes or interprets Customer Input. Third-Party Connectors may be incompatible with Mistral AI Products. Customer will find more details on the compatibility and interoperability of Mistral AI Products with Third-Party Connectors in our documentation. Where a Mistral AI Product allows Customer to store usernames, passwords, API keys, access tokens, or other authentication information ("Credentials") for use by Mistral AI Products, including agents, the foregoing applies equally to such Credentials. In particular, Customer grants us permission to use Customer Credentials to connect to third-party services on Customer’s behalf, and Customer is solely responsible for the Credentials Customer adds and for all actions taken using them at Customer’s request.
rules.scope_note: Additional Terms §5: Customer permits Mistral AI to access a connected Third-Party Connector when Customer enables the connection; this is distinct from the separate permission to send input or execute requested actions.
rules.condition_explanation: customer_enables_connector means Customer enables the Third-Party Connector connection. customer_has_all_necessary_connection_rights means Customer has the rights, licenses, and permissions required to connect it under the Terms.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, the exclusion set out in this Section applies solely to Third-Party Technologies and shall not affect any warranty, obligation, or commitment of Mistral AI under the agreement with respect to the Mistral AI Products, all of which remain in full force and effect, save to the extent they relate to Third-Party Technologies. rules.source_excerpt: 8. Third-Party Content. When Customer uses certain features on a Mistral AI Product, such as web-search, Customer may receive (a)  Output, and (b) content provided by third-parties in the form of additional resources such as hyperlinks, images, thumbnails, or snippets from third-parties to help Customer further explore or understand the Output (the “Third-Party Content”). Such Third-Party Content does not constitute Customer Data or Outputs and Mistral AI does not grant Customer any rights to this Third-Party Content, other than viewing it. For clarity, Mistral AI does not use the Third-Party Content provided in Customer's Data or that is displayed in Outputs to train our artificial intelligence models. Customer is not allowed to use Third-Party Content displayed using Mistral AI's web-search feature to (i) copy, store, archive, cache or create a database of the Third-Party Content, (ii) redistribute, resell, or sublicense the Third-Party Content, (iii) as part of any machine learning or similar algorithmic activity, or (iv) to create, train, evaluate or improve commercial products or services that Customer make available to third-parties.

rules.source_excerpt: (c) Termination. Cohere may, in addition to other relief, terminate this CLA if (i) Client breaches or defaults on any of the material terms or conditions of this CLA and fails to correct such breach within 14 calendar days after receipt of notice of such breach, or (ii) Client becomes insolvent, ceases to conduct business in the ordinary course, takes any step or proceeding available to Client for the benefit of insolvent debtors, or is subject to a proceeding for liquidation, dissolution or winding up, or a receiver, receiver-manager, liquidator or trustee in bankruptcy .

rules.condition_explanation: The breach path requires both a material breach/default and failure to correct within 14 calendar days after notice. rules.source_excerpt: Confidentiality Covenants.  Recipient hereby agrees that during the Term and at all times thereafter it will not, except to exercise its rights or perform its obligations under this Agreement: (i) disclose Confidential Information of the Discloser to any person, except to its own personnel, subcontractors or affiliates that have a “need to know” and that have entered into written agreements no less protective of such Confidential Information than this Agreement, who are directed to hold the Confidential Information in the strictest confidence, and to such other recipients as the Discloser may approve in writing; (ii) use Confidential Information of the Discloser; or (iii) alter or remove from any Confidential Information of the Discloser any proprietary legend. Each Party will take all necessary precautions and measures to safeguard the other Party’s Confidential Information as may be reasonable in the circumstances to prevent improper use or disclosure of the Discloser’s Confidential Information, which will in any event be at least as stringent as the precautions that the Recipient takes to protect its own Confidential Information of a similar type. Recipient shall be responsible for any breach of this Section 10 by any of its personnel, subcontractors or affiliates.

Qualifying permitted recipients must meet the stated need-to-know and written-agreement safeguards. Required safeguards are reasonable precautions at least as stringent as those used to protect the Recipient’s own similar confidential information.

将智谱开放平台使用于任何对主体资格有要求的服务中，包括但不限于医疗、财务、投资、保险、信贷、教育、就业、住房、法律事务、医疗决定或其他重大决定；
利用智谱开放平台用于任何决策行为；
删除智谱开放平台及平台内模型上关于著作权的信息；
对智谱开放平台进行反向工程、反向汇编、反向编译，或者以其他方式尝试发现智谱开放平台的源代码；
对智谱拥有知识产权的内容进行使用、出租、出借、复制、修改、链接、转载、汇编、发表、出版、建立镜像站点等；
除智谱开放的特定功能，您不得对智谱开放平台或者智谱开放平台运行过程中释放到任何终端内存中的数据、软件运行过程中客户端与服务器端的交互数据，以及智谱开放平台运行所必需的系统数据，进行复制、修改、增加、删除、挂接运行或创作任何衍生作品，形式包括但不限于使用插件、外挂或非经智谱授权的第三方工具/服务接入智谱开放平台和相关系统；
通过修改或伪造软件运行中的指令、数据，增加、删减、变动软件的功能或运行效果，或者将用于上述用途的软件、方法进行运营或向公众传播，无论这些行为是否为商业目的；
通过非智谱开发、授权的第三方软件、插件、外挂、系统，登录或使用智谱软件及服务，或制作、发布、传播上述工具；
自行或者授权他人、第三方软件对智谱开放平台及其组件、模块、数据进行干扰；
您除将平台内模型与您具体的业务场景结合后使用外，不得将平台内模型、提示词和通过平台内模型提示生成的内容用于平台内模型之外的新模型或其他模型的开发、训练、标注、微调、优化、迭代以及其他类似活动，不得利用平台内模型或导出数据开发、训练或改善其他与智谱存在竞争关系的算法、模型；
利用智谱开放平台及平台内模型生成恶意代码；
其他未经智谱明示授权的行为和其他可能损害智谱利益的使用方式。
rules.scope_note: Main user agreement, platform, platform models, platform-related data, code, and other platform intellectual-property content. Restrictions cover extraction, specified high-stakes or decision uses, removal of copyright information, reverse engineering, exploitation of Zhipu IP, unauthorized technical interference or tools, competitive model activity, malicious-code generation, and other unauthorized or harmful use. The specific-function exception applies to the copying/modification/etc. restriction in line 76; the specific-business-scenario exception applies to the model/prompt/generated-content restriction in line 80.
rules.condition_explanation: use_involves_any_enumerated_prohibited_method means any action listed in lines 70–82. For line 76, copying, modifying, adding, deleting, hooking into, or creating derivative works from the specified platform data or systems is prohibited except through a specific function opened by Zhipu. For line 80, use of platform models, prompts, or model-generated content for other-model development/training/annotation/fine-tuning/optimization/iteration is prohibited except combining the platform model with the user’s specific business scenario; use of platform models or exported data to develop, train, or improve competing algorithms or models is also prohibited.

obligation_items.content: Do not attempt to extract data, parameters, or code from the platform; use it for listed qualification-dependent services or any decision-making; remove copyright information; reverse engineer, disassemble, decompile, or otherwise seek source code; or exploit Zhipu intellectual-property content in the listed ways.
obligation_items.object: platform, platform models, and Zhipu intellectual-property content
obligation_items.trigger: Any use of the platform or its intellectual-property content.

obligation_items.content: Do not copy, modify, add to, delete, hook into, or create derivative works from the platform, specified runtime-memory data, client-server interaction data, or system data necessary to run the platform, except through a specific function opened by Zhipu; do not use unauthorized plugins,外挂, or third-party tools or services to connect to the platform or related systems.
obligation_items.object: platform and its specified runtime, interaction, and system data
obligation_items.trigger: The conduct concerns the specified platform or data and is not performed through a specific function opened by Zhipu.

obligation_items.content: Do not alter or forge software instructions or data to change functions or effects, or operate or publicly distribute software or methods for those purposes, whether or not commercially; do not use non-Zhipu-developed or unauthorized third-party software, plugins,外挂, or systems to access or use the service, or make, publish, or distribute those tools; do not interfere with the platform, its components, modules, or data.
obligation_items.object: platform software, service, components, modules, and data
obligation_items.trigger: Any listed alteration, distribution, unauthorized access, tool-making, or interference.

obligation_items.content: Do not use platform models, prompts, or content generated through platform-model prompts for development, training, annotation, fine-tuning, optimization, iteration, or similar activity involving a new or other model, except use that combines the platform model with the user’s specific business scenario; do not use platform models or exported data to develop, train, or improve an algorithm or model that competes with Zhipu.
obligation_items.object: platform models, prompts, model-generated content, and exported data
obligation_items.trigger: The use is for an activity or competing-model purpose stated in line 80 and is not the stated specific-business-scenario exception.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the platform or its models to generate malicious code or engage in other conduct not expressly authorized by Zhipu or that may harm Zhipu’s interests.
obligation_items.object: platform and platform models
obligation_items.trigger: The conduct generates malicious code or is otherwise unauthorized or potentially harmful to Zhipu’s interests.

rules.source_excerpt: 5.您利用智谱开放平台及其中模型向任何第三方提供服务，相应的权利义务和责任均由您承担，智谱开放平台不对由此造成的任何损失负责。
rules.scope_note: Main user agreement, user-provided services to third parties using the platform or its models. The user bears the corresponding rights, duties, and responsibilities; this is not a general platform-service resale grant.
rules.condition_explanation: user_accepts_all_corresponding_rights_duties_and_liabilities means the user, not Zhipu, assumes the rights, obligations, and responsibilities arising from providing the third-party service.

obligation_items.content: Bear the rights, obligations, and responsibilities associated with the service provided to the third party using the platform or its models.
obligation_items.object: service provided to the third party using the platform or its models
obligation_items.trigger: The user provides a service to any third party using the platform or its models.

rules.source_excerpt: 6.您在海外使用智谱开放平台应遵守美国、欧盟和/或其他政府机关等外国实体的全部法律、法规、政策的限制与监督。您不得将智谱开放平台或使用智谱开放平台开发的任何产品转售、出口或转移至受监管控制的特定国家和特定人士。未事先获得相关政府机关的必要批准及智谱事先同意，您不得直接或间接出口智谱开放平台或包含有智谱开放平台的任何技术、智谱开放平台内部的技术。
rules.scope_note: Main user agreement, platform and products developed using it. Overseas use must follow applicable foreign restrictions and supervision. Transfers/resales/exports to regulated countries or persons are prohibited; direct or indirect export of the platform or technology containing it requires the government approvals and Zhipu’s prior consent specified in the agreement.
rules.condition_explanation: use_or_transfer_is_overseas_or_export_related includes overseas platform use, resale/export/transfer to regulated countries or persons, and export of the platform or technology containing or internal to it. For export of the platform or such technology, both necessary government approval and prior Zhipu consent are required.

obligation_items.content: Comply with applicable US, EU, and other foreign-government laws, regulations, policies, restrictions, and supervision when using the platform overseas.
obligation_items.object: overseas platform use
obligation_items.trigger: The user uses the platform overseas.

obligation_items.content: Do not resell, export, or transfer the platform or a product developed using it to a regulated country or regulated person.
obligation_items.object: platform or product developed using the platform
obligation_items.trigger: The destination is a country or person subject to regulated controls.

obligation_items.content: Do not directly or indirectly export the platform or technology containing or internal to it unless necessary government approvals and Zhipu’s prior consent have both been obtained.
obligation_items.object: platform and technology containing or internal to the platform
obligation_items.trigger: A direct or indirect export is proposed and either necessary government approval or Zhipu’s prior consent is absent.

rules.source_excerpt:
(1) 您对智谱开放平台提供的任何服务的使用均应符合《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》以及适用的其他法律法规、政策、标准等。
(2) 您调用智谱开放平台内模型 API 开发的产品和应用，由您负责自行进行互联网信息服务算法备案、具有舆论属性或社会动员能力的互联网信息服务安全评估、上线备案等合规程序，以及其他基于法律法规及政策所要求的审批、备案、评估及流程。
(3) 您应按照相关规定和主管机关要求真实、准确地公示使用智谱开放平台内模型及其他模型（如有）的情况，请勿对未使用智谱开放平台内模型的产品和服务进行虚假的、混淆事实的公示、标识及展示。
(4) 您应对应用生成内容的安全性、合法性、合规性进行有效管理和控制，建立包括但不限于内容审核、用户管理、数据安全、监测预警和应急处置等机制。
(5) 鉴于API返回的信息不一定毫无瑕疵，您应对发现的或被提示的违法和不良信息及时依法采取删除、屏蔽、撤回等处置措施，确保应用合法合规运营。
(6) 如您利用智谱开放平台创建虚拟人物，需保证虚拟人物的形象、头像、名称、人物设定及创建过程中的数据和内容均不侵犯第三方权益，不会利用虚拟人物从事任何可能构成不正当竞争的行为。
(7) 未经智谱事先书面同意，您不得通过出租、出借、出售、分销、转售、转让、共享账号、转授权、二次封装、服务中转、聚合中转或其他变相方式，向任何第三方提供智谱开放平台服务，或提供与本服务相关的 API Key、API Token、访问凭证、账号权限或其他服务能力。为免疑义，您将本服务依法合规集成至您自有产品、应用或功能中，并向该等产品、应用或功能的终端用户提供服务的，不视为前述受限行为，但您应确保该等使用符合本协议及智谱不时发布的产品规则、订阅规则。
(8) 您违反前述法律法规和约定造成的后果由您自行承担，由于您的行为给智谱开放平台造成损失的，您应赔偿由此造成的损失。
rules.scope_note: Main user agreement, platform services and API-developed products/apps. Covers applicable law, filings and assessments, accurate model-use disclosures, generated-content governance, handling illegal or harmful API responses, virtual-person rights and competition, and restrictions on third-party service provision. Service resale, credentials-sharing and equivalent provision require prior written consent; lawful compliant integration into the user’s own product for its end users is expressly not treated as restricted conduct, subject to agreement and product/subscription rules.
rules.condition_explanation: applicable_law_compliance_and_service_specific_duties means compliance with the cited and other applicable laws, regulations, policies, and standards; required filings and assessments for API-developed products; truthful and accurate disclosures; effective safety, legality, and compliance controls; timely handling of discovered or reported illegal or harmful responses; and, when creating virtual persons, protection of third-party rights and avoidance of unfair competition. The third-party service restriction in line 92 has a prior-written-consent exception and an own-product compliant-integration exception.

obligation_items.content: Use platform services in compliance with the cited generative-AI, algorithm-recommendation, deep-synthesis, and other applicable laws, regulations, policies, and standards.
obligation_items.object: platform services
obligation_items.trigger: Any use of platform services.

obligation_items.content: Complete applicable algorithm filing, security assessment, launch filing, approval, evaluation, and other legally or policy-required compliance procedures for products and applications developed using the platform’s model API.
obligation_items.object: API-developed product or application
obligation_items.trigger: The user calls a platform model API to develop a product or application, to the extent the procedure is required by applicable law or policy.

obligation_items.content: Accurately and truthfully disclose use of platform models and any other models as required by applicable rules and authorities, and do not falsely or misleadingly label or display a product or service as using a platform model when it does not.
obligation_items.object: model-use disclosures, labels, and displays for products and services
obligation_items.trigger: The user represents model use in a product or service.

obligation_items.content: Effectively manage and control the safety, legality, and compliance of application-generated content, establishing mechanisms including content review, user management, data security, monitoring and warning, and emergency response.
obligation_items.object: application-generated content and application controls
obligation_items.trigger: The user operates an application that generates content.

obligation_items.content: Promptly take legally required deletion, blocking, withdrawal, or other disposition measures for illegal or harmful information discovered in or reported from API responses, to ensure lawful and compliant application operation.
obligation_items.object: illegal or harmful information returned by the API
obligation_items.trigger: The user discovers or is notified of illegal or harmful information in an API response.

obligation_items.content: Ensure a virtual person’s appearance, avatar, name, character setting, and creation-process data and content do not infringe third-party rights, and do not use the virtual person for conduct that may constitute unfair competition.
obligation_items.object: virtual person and its creation-process data and content
obligation_items.trigger: The user creates a virtual person using the platform.

obligation_items.content: Do not provide the platform service, related API keys, tokens, credentials, account permissions, or other service capabilities to a third party by rental, loan, sale, distribution, resale, transfer, account sharing, sublicense, repackaging, service relay, aggregation relay, or equivalent means without prior written Zhipu consent.
obligation_items.object: platform service and related access credentials or service capabilities
obligation_items.trigger: The user proposes to provide them to a third party through a listed or equivalent means and lacks Zhipu’s prior written consent.

obligation_items.content: Ensure that integration of the service into the user’s own product, application, or function for its end users complies with the agreement and Zhipu’s applicable product and subscription rules.
obligation_items.object: integrated service and own product, application, or function
obligation_items.trigger: The user relies on the own-product integration exception to provide service to end users.

obligation_items.content: Bear the consequences of violations of the stated laws and requirements and compensate Zhipu for losses caused by the user’s conduct.
obligation_items.object: losses suffered by Zhipu and consequences of the user’s conduct
obligation_items.trigger: The user violates the stated laws or requirements, or the user’s conduct causes loss to Zhipu.

rules.source_excerpt:
8. 未经智谱事先书面同意，您不得在任何时候、以任何方式、通过任何途径（无论是直接还是间接，也无论是明示还是暗示，包括但不限于任何营销、广告、促销、市场推广或其他目的）：
（1）使用、引用、公布、复制、展示（公开或非公开）、提及、注册或申请注册：(i) 智谱或其关联方拥有或有权使用的任何商标（无论是否已注册）、商号、名称、标志或者标识（包括但不限于：“智谱”、“智谱AI”、“Zhipu”、“Zhipu.AI”、“ChatGLM”、“CodeGeeX”、“CogView”，或与清华大学有关的任何文字及标志等），或通过特定描述使第三方能够识别智谱或其任何关联方；(ii) 智谱或其关联方任何董事、监事、管理人员、雇员或合伙人、科学家团队的姓名、肖像、形象、照片、图片、标识、发言或评论（或其一部分）；或 (iii) 与前述各项相似的、以任何语言形式存在的任何名称、商标、标识、文字、词语、符号或其任何组合；以及
（2）直接或间接声明您或您的任何关联方所提供的任何产品或服务已由智谱或其任何关联方认可或支持。特别地，未经智谱事先书面确认和承诺，您不得将智谱相关的宣传/广告/影响策略及内容向任何第三方进行宣传或披露、亦不得利用智谱或其相关方品牌直接或间接谋求及/或招揽任何投资及/或合作机会。如您违反前述约定的，智谱有权要求您立即删除相关内容并负责消除影响、赔偿智谱的所有损失。
rules.scope_note: Main user agreement, Zhipu and affiliate marks, names, identifying descriptions, personnel and team attributes, and endorsement claims, across any channel or purpose. Prior written consent is required; specified publicity/advertising/influence content and investment or cooperation solicitation additionally require prior written confirmation and commitment.
rules.condition_explanation: use_or_publicity_identifies_zhipu_or_related_persons_or_claims_endorsement covers the listed use, quotation, publication, display, mention, or registration of marks or identifying information; use of listed personal attributes; similarity-based identifiers; and claims of Zhipu or affiliate endorsement. zhipu_prior_written_consent means consent obtained in writing in advance; the additional publicity and solicitation acts require the written confirmation and commitment stated in line 96.

obligation_items.content: Do not use, cite, publish, copy, display, mention, register, or seek registration of the listed Zhipu or affiliate marks, identifiers, identifying descriptions, or listed personal and team attributes without prior written consent.
obligation_items.object: Zhipu and affiliate marks, identifying information, and listed personnel or team attributes
obligation_items.trigger: The proposed conduct identifies Zhipu, an affiliate, or listed persons and prior written consent has not been obtained.

obligation_items.content: Do not state directly or indirectly that the user’s or an affiliate’s products or services are endorsed or supported by Zhipu or its affiliates without prior written consent; do not publicize or disclose Zhipu-related promotional, advertising, or influence strategy or content, or use the brand to solicit investment or cooperation, without the stated prior written confirmation and commitment.
obligation_items.object: endorsement statements and Zhipu-related promotional content or solicitation
obligation_items.trigger: The user proposes an endorsement claim, publicity or disclosure, or investment/cooperation solicitation and has not obtained the applicable prior written consent or confirmation and commitment.

rules.source_excerpt: 9.如您在使用智谱开放平台及平台内模型的过程中加入新的数据进行模型训练、微调和开发，由此产生的责任由您自行承担。您进行训练、微调和开发后，受有损害并主张智谱承担责任的，应证明损害与其训练、微调和开发无关，否则智谱对损害免责。
rules.scope_note: Main user agreement, training, fine-tuning, and development with new data added during use of the platform or its models. If the user seeks to hold Zhipu responsible for resulting damage, the user must prove the damage is unrelated to that training, fine-tuning, or development.
rules.condition_explanation: user_adds_new_data_to_train_fine_tune_or_develop_model_during_platform_use means the user adds new data in the course of using the platform or its models for model training, fine-tuning, or development.

obligation_items.content: Assume responsibility for consequences arising from model training, fine-tuning, or development using newly added data.
obligation_items.object: training, fine-tuning, or development using newly added data
obligation_items.trigger: The user adds new data to train, fine-tune, or develop a model while using the platform or its models.

obligation_items.content: Prove that claimed damage is unrelated to the user’s training, fine-tuning, or development in order to claim that Zhipu is responsible for that damage.
obligation_items.actor: user seeking to hold Zhipu responsible
obligation_items.object: claimed damage arising after training, fine-tuning, or development
obligation_items.trigger: The user has trained, fine-tuned, or developed a model and claims Zhipu is responsible for resulting damage.

rules.source_excerpt:
您理解并认可，您通过智谱开放平台上传、存储、处理的所有数据（以下简称“用户上传数据”）均为您所有，您对用户上传数据的内容和来源负全部责任。您应确保上传的数据：
内容安全合法，不包含违法违规及不良内容；
不侵犯任何第三方的合法权益，包括但不限于知识产权、商业秘密、肖像权、隐私权、姓名权等；
如包含个人信息，必须是依据《个人信息保护法》及所适用的法律法规合法取得授权的个人信息。
就用户上传数据，智谱开放平台除执行您的服务要求外，不会进行任何未获授权的使用及披露；除非：
在国家有关机关依法查询或调阅用户上传数据时，智谱开放平台有义务按照相关法律法规或政策文件要求提供配合；
您与智谱开放平台另行协商一致。
rules.scope_note: Main user agreement, user-uploaded data. User retains ownership and responsibility for content and source; Zhipu may use or disclose it only to execute service instructions, except legally required cooperation with authorities or separate agreement.
rules.condition_explanation: data_is_lawful_noninfringing_and_authorized_personal_information means the data is safe and lawful, contains no illegal, noncompliant, or harmful content, infringes no third-party rights, and, if it contains personal information, was obtained with legally valid authorization.

obligation_items.content: Ensure uploaded data is safe and lawful, contains no illegal, noncompliant, or harmful content, does not infringe third-party rights, and includes personal information only when lawfully obtained with required authorization.
obligation_items.object: user-uploaded data
obligation_items.trigger: The user uploads, stores, or processes data through the platform.

obligation_items.content: Do not use or disclose user-uploaded data except to perform the user’s service requirements, unless legally required to cooperate with an authority or separately agreed with the user.
obligation_items.object: user-uploaded data
obligation_items.trigger: The provider proposes to use or disclose user-uploaded data outside performance of the user’s service requirements and neither legally required authority cooperation nor a separate agreement applies.

rules.source_excerpt:
您从智谱开放平台导出的非用户上传数据的数据（以下简称“导出数据”）应当遵守以下使用限制：
您不得将导出数据用于直接销售、转售、许可给第三方或作为独立数据产品进行商业化使用；
您不得利用导出数据开发、修改与本公司有竞争关系的模型或产品；
导出数据一经下载并由您进行修改后，智谱开放平台不再对其完整性、安全性与合规性负责；
因使用导出数据产生的任何责任与后果均由您自行承担；
如因您对导出数据的不当使用导致智谱开放平台遭受任何损失，您应当承担全部赔偿责任。
rules.scope_note: Main user agreement, exported data obtained from the platform excluding user-uploaded data. Direct sale, resale, licensing to third parties, commercialization as an independent data product, and development or modification of competing models or products are prohibited. User bears responsibility for use and resulting consequences; after download and user modification the platform disclaims responsibility for integrity, security, and compliance.
rules.condition_explanation: data_is_exported_non_user_uploaded_data means data exported from the platform that is not user-uploaded data. The allowed condition excludes each of the prohibited commercialization paths and use to develop or modify a model or product competing with the company.

obligation_items.content: Do not directly sell or resell exported data, license it to a third party, or commercialize it as an independent data product.
obligation_items.object: exported non-user-uploaded data
obligation_items.trigger: The data was exported from the platform and is not user-uploaded data.

obligation_items.content: Do not use exported data to develop or modify a model or product competing with the company.
obligation_items.object: exported non-user-uploaded data
obligation_items.trigger: The user proposes to use exported data to develop or modify a competing model or product.

obligation_items.content: Bear responsibility for consequences of using exported data and compensate the platform for losses caused by improper use.
obligation_items.object: exported non-user-uploaded data and resulting losses

rules.scope_note: General terms §§3.4.1–3.4.2. Covers prepaid and postpaid services. 3.4.3.    为改善用户体验，完善服务内容，阿里云有权定期或不定期对产品、服务、平台、系统、软件等进行升级、维护优化等日程巡检及维护，在不影响您正常使用的情况下可能导致您所使用的服务短时间的中断或暂停。阿里云无须针对此中断或暂停向您承担任何责任，但阿里云应当在合理时间提前通知您。
3.4.4.     发生下列情形之一的，服务期限提前终止：
(1)    双方协商一致提前终止的；
(2)    您严重违反本协议（包括您严重违反相关法律法规规定，或您严重违反本协议项下之任一承诺内容等），阿里云有权提前终止服务直至清除您的全部数据；
(3)    您理解并充分认可，虽然阿里云已经建立（并将根据技术的发展不断完善）必要的技术措施来防御包括计算机病毒、网络入侵和攻击破坏（包括DDoS）等危害网络安全事项或行为（以下统称该等行为），但鉴于网络安全技术的局限性、相对性以及该等行为的不可预见性，因此如因您网站遭遇该等行为而给阿里云或者阿里云的其他网络或服务器（包括本地及外地和国际的网络、服务器等）带来危害，或影响阿里云与国际互联网或者阿里云与特定网络、服务器及阿里云内部的通畅联系，阿里云可决定暂停或终止服务。如果终止服务的，将按照实际提供服务月份计算（不足一个月的按天计）服务费用，将剩余款项（如有）返还。
(4)   服务因阿里云无法控制的事由而无法提供（包括但不限于不可抗力），或继续提供服务将导致您或阿里云违反适用的法律、法规或规章。
(5)   阿里云可不时修改、终止服务，在我们终止提供您正在使用的任何服务或任何服务功能之前，我们将提前30日在阿里云网站上通告或给您发网站内通知或其他书面通知的方式通知您，届时阿里云应将您已预付但未消费的款项退还至您的阿里云账户。您知悉并确认，部分产品服务或产品服务中的部分功能的终止并不影响您在使用其他产品服务时依据对本协议的遵守。
3.4.5.    您理解并认可，为技术升级、服务体系升级、或因经营策略调整或配合国家重大技术、法规政策等变化，阿里云不保证永久的提供某种服务，并有权变更所提供服务的形式、规格或其他方面（如服务的价格和计费模式），在终止该种服务或进行此种变更前，阿里云将尽最大努力且提前以网站公告、站内信、邮件或短信等一种或多种方式进行事先通知。
rules.scope_note: General terms §§3.4.3–3.4.5. Alibaba Cloud may perform maintenance and may modify or terminate services. rules.source_excerpt:
4.1.     服务费用将在您订购页面予以列明公示，您可自行选择具体服务类型并按列明的价格予以支付。您可选择先付费或后付费的服务。
4.2.     先付费
4.2.1.     在您付费之后，阿里云才开始为您提供服务。您未在下单后立即付费的，订单将为您保留7日，7日届满您仍未付费或者7日内阿里云服务售罄的，订单失效，订单失效后阿里云与您就服务所达成的合意失效。
4.2.2.     服务期满双方愿意继续合作的，您至少应在服务期满前7日内支付续费款项，以使服务得以继续进行。
4.3.     后付费
您可先使用后付费。具体扣费规则请查看阿里云网站上的页面展示且以页面公布的后付费服务当时有效的计费模式和标准为准。
4.4.     阿里云会定期或不定期推出优惠活动或政策（统称为“优惠活动”），例如：一次性订购满一定期限或服务量，赠送一定服务内容、延长服务期限或提供直接折扣、发放免费代金券，双十一产品特价/折扣，推荐码优惠等等形式。您理解并确认：
4.4.1.     您完全理解阿里云价格体系中所有的赠送服务项目或优惠活动均为阿里云在正常服务价格之外的一次性特别优惠，赠送的服务项目或优惠活动不可折价、冲抵服务价格。
4.4.2.     由于部分优惠活动或政策是基于您对于服务时长或服务量的使用承诺为前提，因此，若您无理由擅自退订相应服务，阿里云有权采取恢复原价计费、收取违约金或收取退订/退款手续费、支付已使用免费代金券的等值金额等一种或多种方式进行处理，以相应官网展示页面或相应订单中载明的方式为准。
4.4.3.     除非您所订购的产品/服务另有明确约定，或您与阿里云以书面形式另有其他明确约定，否则，多种优惠不可同时叠加适用。
4.4.4.    就您所订购的产品/服务享受的优惠活动或政策，您负有保密义务；一经发现您未能遵守本条保密义务，阿里云有权取消该等优惠，并有权决定是否暂停或终止服务。
4.5.     您理解并认可，阿里云可能通过开展邀请测试、公测等方式为您提供免费产品/服务或在一定使用额度内为您提供免费产品/服务，在免费期间或免费额度内，您不需支付产品/服务费用；阿里云不排除日后收取费用的可能，届时阿里云将提前10个自然日通过在网站内合适版面发布公告或发送站内通知等方式公布收费政策及规范；如果收费期开始后您仍使用相应产品/服务的，您应按届时有效的收费政策为后续使用的产品/服务付费。您理解并同意，如您使用阿里云标记为“邀测”或“公测”的产品（“预览版产品”）的，应同步遵守《阿里云预览版产品使用条款》的约定。
4.6.     您同意，我们有权对付费服务的价格进行调整，并提前30日以合理的方式通知予您。新价格生效后，您需要接受新调整的价格才能继续购买相关服务，您在价格调整前购买的服务不受影响。若您不接受调整后的价格，可停止购买相关服务。
4.7.     请您采用我们支持的付款方式付款。付款人应与您在阿里云官网注册或实名认证的名称一致，如因付款主体与认证主体不一致导致金融合规风险，相关后果由您自行承担。
4.8.     您知悉并了解，我们可能会根据与您的协议及您采购的服务等情况进行结算并向您发送账单。除另有约定外，当您对账单有异议时，您应在收到账单后5个工作日内提出，逾期未提出时，视为您对账单无异议。如您在前述时间对账单提出异议的，则由双方友好协商解决，协商期间，您应先行支付无异议部分的金额；如协商不成而您又未提供充分依据支撑时，则以阿里云系统数据为准。
4.9.     为便利您的操作，您可以对一些服务设置“自动续费”。自动续费是指您所购买的阿里云服务到期时，您的阿里云账号内可用余额足够的，系统自动从您的账号中扣取下一续费周期的费用。除另有明确约定外，自动续费的价格为系统执行扣费当时的价格。（如适用）
4.10.   阿里云将严格遵照国家税务规定向您开具合规的增值税发票。如发生销售折让、销售退回或其他按照国家税务规定需要重新开票或开具红字发票的情况，您需退回阿里云已开具的发票或提供开具红字专用发票的必要资料。具体按以下政策执行：
4.10.1.  如果退票发生在发票开具当月且您尚未进行税务认证抵扣，您退回发票即可。
4.10.2.  如果您已就该发票进行税务认证抵扣，或者退票时间已超过开票当月，您应向阿里云提供开具红字发票的必要资料，如《开具红字增值税专用发票信息表》等。
4.10.3.  如果阿里云尚未开具发票或已开具发票但尚未交付给您，无需您提供发票相关资料。
在完成上述操作后，您可按照向阿里云的实际付款（应付款）数额申请重新开具发票，双方办理相应的退款。不符合上述条件的，则无法办理重新开票和退款，阿里云不就此承担任何责任。
